android.desc:
Nutrition AI is your personal AI nutritionist. Tell it your goal, and in about three minutes you get a complete week of meals built around your body, your diet and the food you love - with recipes, calories, macros and one shopping list.

🎯 BUILT AROUND YOU
• Describe your goal in your own words: lose weight, build muscle, eat healthier, train for a race
• Add your age, height, weight and how active you are
• Choose a diet style: vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, low-carb, keto, high-protein, halal, kosher - or eat everything
• List your allergies and the foods you dislike, and they are kept out of your plan
• Pick your cooking time, budget and favourite cuisines
• Mention anything else - shift work, training, family life, a health condition - and your plan takes it into account

🍽️ YOUR WEEK OF MEALS
• 7 days of breakfasts, lunches, dinners and snacks
• Calories, protein, carbs and fat for every meal
• A full recipe for every meal, with ingredient quantities and a step-by-step method

📊 NUMBERS THAT ADD UP
• Daily calorie and macro targets calculated for your body, activity and goal
• Every day of the plan checked against your target
• A plain-language explanation of what your numbers mean

🛒 SHOPPING AND PREP MADE EASY
• One shopping list for the whole week, grouped and totalled - tick items off as you shop
• A meal-prep guide to batch-cook and save time on busy days

📖 A PLAN GUIDE WRITTEN FOR YOU
• How your targets work and what to expect
• Tips to fit the plan around your work, family and training
• Smart swaps that respect your diet, allergies and dislikes
• How to track your progress, plus a checklist for your first few days

✅ STAY ON TRACK
• Tick off meals as you eat them
• Set meal reminders so you never miss a meal
• Goal or routine changed? Update your details and rebuild your plan - 3 rewrites come with every plan

🤖 HOW IT WORKS
Every plan is built in stages, each handled by AI with its own job: a nutritionist that sets your targets and plans your week, a chef that writes your recipes, and a planner that builds your shopping list, prep guide and plan guide. Each plan is then checked by code for calorie accuracy and against the allergies you listed.

💳 SIMPLE PRICING
• Free to download, and free to browse complete example plans - no sign-up needed
• 2.99€ per plan - a one-off payment, not a subscription
• Every plan includes 3 rewrites

Nutrition AI provides general nutrition information and is not medi

quotes.text:
Hello everyone !

My brother and I have been developing the "Nutrition AI" app and would love yor feedback so we can improve it! 
We are both software developers and have been working on this in our free time, as we wanted a cheaper alternative to get nutritional advice.

How it works:
You describe your goal (lose fat, explore cuisines, lower my sugar level etc)
and you get personalized:

- Multiple daily meals & recipes
- Detailed ingredients & nutritional facts
- Personalized advice for the plan
- Weekly grocery shopping list

Your plan & details can be viewed anytime in the app (or website) in organized screens. (attached in this post)

The app uses multiple ChatGPT-4 agents behind the scenes. So a complete nutrition plan costs 3 euros.
You can also change any of your personal details and re-generate the whole plan 3 more times for free.
We also provide a few completely free plans as examples. You can find those in the main menu.

All plans are provided for educational purposes.

Website: www.nutritionai.app
Android: Nutrition AI (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.nutritionai.twa)
iOS:     We are working on it!
